answers.core: Yes, because it affects fundamental editor workflows (renaming nodes, files, inspector values, text input fields) and is not limited to specific project code. A plugin cannot reliably hook into every text input throughout the editor UI consistently.
answers.workaround:
Not easily:

There’s no global built-in editor function for these conversions.

Scripts cannot modify core editor widgets like LineEdit across all contexts.

While some conversions can be done via manual sequence calls (e.g., to_snake_case()), it requires todos by user input and doesn’t integrate with editor workflows.

title: Add case conversion across editor (PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE)
